---
title: Mini Program Configuration
sidebar_label: Mini Program Configuration
---

The `app.json` file in the root of the Mini Program provides global configuration of the whole program.

## Configuration items

| Properties    | Type            | Required | Description                             | Minimum Version |
| ------------- | --------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| configVersion | `string`        | YES      | Configuration file version number.      | -               |
| app           | `object`        | YES      | Mini Program configuration information. | -               |
| permissions   | `Array<string>` | YES      | List of Mini Program permissions.       | -               |
| targets       | `object`        | YES      | Build Mini Program installer setup.     | -               |
| debug         | `boolean`       | NO       | Mini Program debugging function.        | -               |

### configVersion

Examples are as follows：

```js
{
  "configVersion": "v3"
}
```

### app

| Properties | Type     | Required | Description               | Minimum Version |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------- | --------------- |
| appId      | `number` | YES      | The Mini Program "id".    | v2              |
| version    | `object` | YES      | Version information.      | v2              |
| venderId   | `number` | NO       | Developer id.             | -               |

#### version: object

| Properties | Type     | Required | Description                  | Minimum Version |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------- | --------------- |
| code       | `number` | YES      | Program version number.      | -               |
| name       | `string` | YES      | Semantic version.            | -               |

Examples are as follows:

```js
{
  "app": {
    "appId": 1000089,
    "version": {
      "code": 5,
      "name": "0.0.5"
    }
  }
}
```

### permissions: Array

```js
{
  "permissions": []
}
```

### targets: object

| Properties  | Type            | Required | Description                        | Minimum Version |
| ----------- | --------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------- |
| module      | `object`        | YES      | Function module configuration.     | v2              |
| platforms   | `Array<object>` | YES      | Running platform device selection. | v2              |
| designWidth | `number`        | YES      | The design width of the view.      | v2              |

### module: object

| Properties  | Type     | Required                                     | Description                             | Minimum Version |
| ----------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| page        | `object` | YES, required when `appType` is `app`.       | The configuration of page in Device App module . | v2       |
| app-side    | `object` | NO                                           | The configuration of companion module.  | v2              |
| setting     | `object` | NO                                           | The configuration of Settings App module. | v2            |
| app-service | `object` | NO                                           | The configuration of Background Service. | v3             |

#### page: object

| Properties | Type            | Required | Description               | Minimum Version |
| ---------- | --------------- | -------- | ------------------------- | --------------- |
| pages      | `Array<string>` | YES      | Page path, at least one.  | v2              |

#### app-side: object

| Properties | Type     | Required | Description               | Minimum Version |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------- | --------------- |
| path       | `string` | NO       | The path of Side Service. | v2              |

#### setting: object

| Properties | Type     | Required | Description               | Minimum Version |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------- | --------------- |
| path       | `string` | YES      | The path of Settings App. | v2              |

#### platforms: object

| Properties   | Type     | Required   | Description               | Minimum Version |
| ------------ | -------- | ---------- | ------------------------- | --------------- |
| name         | `string` | NO         | Device description.       | v2              |
| deviceSource | `number` | YES, v3 NO | Number of the equipment.  | v2              |

Examples are as follows：

```js
{
  "platforms": [{
    "name": "gts-3",
    "deviceSource": 229
  }]
}
```

#### designWidth

```js
{
  "designWidth": 390
}
```

## Complete app.json example

```js
{
  "configVersion": "v2",
  "app": {
    "appId": 1000000
  },
  "permissions": [],
  "targets": {
    "gtr-3": {
      "module": {
        "page": {
          "pages": ["page/gtr-3/index"]
        }
      },
      "designWidth": 480
    }
  }
}
```
